main.description: Mint the standing signup invite: a customers-space invite with read access, no use limit and no expiry, for the HAPPYPROTO_SIGNUP_INVITE script variable that actor.signUp reads. The token is answered once and kept nowhere. Staff only, and the caller must be the customers space's creator or a HappyView super user.

token.description: The invite's token. Anyone holding it can join the customers space.

inviteId.description: HappyView's id for the invite, for revoking it.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: This endpoint requires an authenticated caller.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not staff, or is neither the customers space's creator nor a HappyView super user.

errors.name: Upstream
errors.description: The customers space is not configured or could not make an invite.
